high_level_description: This image captures a close-up view of a person's wrist and hand, with the focus on a wristwatch. The watch is a Tommy Hilfiger model, featuring a white dial with black hour markers and hands, a blue bezel, and a brown leather strap. The watch face includes a tachymeter scale at the top, indicating it has a chronograph function. The person's hand is positioned palm up, with fingers slightly spread apart. The skin appears to be dry or flaky, particularly noticeable on the fingers and the back of the hand. The background shows a patterned fabric, possibly a bedspread or blanket
